description: 3 positives (1 de) + 3 near-misses. This lens hunts for DELETION — code that should not exist, a dependency the platform already covers, a clever form where a flat one reads better. The near-misses are the three reviews that hunt for additions instead: missing tests, a security gap, and a performance fix.

queries.q: is any of this over-engineered? what could we just delete
we pulled in a library for something the stdlib already does — check the diff for that pattern
schau, ob die Abstraktion hier ueberhaupt noetig ist oder nur Ballast
which branches of this function are untested?
does this endpoint check tenant ownership before returning the row?
this loop is slow — make it faster
